item.title: Large-scale iontronic skins with neural-hierarchical processing architecture
item.content:encoded:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 16 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01325-6

Li et al. introduce a neural-hierarchical skin that combines high-density iontronic sensor array, fast readout and data compression, enabling humanoid robots to perceive fine textures, manipulate delicate objects and respond to nociceptive stimuli.

item.title: An all-in-one foundation model for multimodal medical image restoration and enhancement
item.content:encoded:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 13 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01310-z

Cao et al. present AMIFound, a foundation model that unifies medical image restoration across seven imaging modalities, delivering robust enhancement across diverse degradations and preserving clinically relevant information for diagnosis.
